summary: WebXR app for Quest 3: explore Moon & Mars with hand-tracking as spacecraft tell their stories.
details: Immersive space story is an immersive, browser-based WebXR application designed for Meta Quest 3 and Xreal aura AR glasses that brings historic space exploration directly to your hands. Built with A-Frame and zero installation hurdles, users step into authentic lunar, Martian, and 360° deep-space environments using intuitive hand-tracking and a kid-friendly palm-anchored UI. By selecting decommissioned equipment hotspots on the Moon and Mars, high-fidelity 3D models (such as the Apollo Lunar Module, Dawn, and Opportunity) appear on interactive pedestals. Through engaging first-person audio narration and spatial HUD panels, each spacecraft directly tells its own story—sharing who it is, its mission, and its greatest scientific discoveries—while users freely rotate and inspect the models with natural hand gestures.
